title: Mercy Ancient-Text Translation Corpus
purpose: Independent Mercy translations made directly from legally reusable ancient-language source texts, not from copyrighted modern English translations.
policy: Translate from a verified Greek, Latin, Syriac, Coptic, Armenian, Georgian or other ancient-language witness.
Record the exact source edition, publication data, source location, rights/provenance and language for every translated unit.
Keep original ancient text, Mercy translation, translator notes and historical public-domain comparison translations visually and structurally distinct.
Do not derive Mercy translations from copyrighted modern English translations.
Use modern scholarship only as a secondary aid for lexicography, textual criticism, historical context and difficult readings.
Mark disputed authorship, fragmentary transmission, reconstructed text and uncertain readings explicitly.
Version Mercy translations so later philological review can amend them without obscuring earlier states.
